pins.definition: Feeling the effect of something unexpected.
Feeling or showing surprise because something unexpected has happened.

situation: A young man sitting in his living room drops his coffee mug when a cat suddenly leaps out from his unopened cardboard delivery box.
subject: the sudden realization of an unexpected event
brief: A young man sits rigidly on his living room sofa with wide, unblinking eyes and an open mouth, frozen mid-air as a dark brown ceramic mug slips from his slackened fingers and tumbles toward the rug. From the cardboard parcel open on the coffee table directly in front of him, a ginger cat stares back with equal astonishment, both caught in a moment of sheer unexpected interruption.
